data.one_liner: A HTTP inspector for Dio, which can intercept and log HTTP requests and responses.
data.what_it_does: Intercepts and logs HTTP requests and responses for Dio. Provides a user interface to view, filter, search, and share request details directly inside the app.
use_when: You need to debug and inspect network traffic in a Dio-based Flutter app
You want a built-in UI tool to view request headers, bodies, status codes, and copy data to cURL
avoid_when: You are not using Dio for networking
You prefer external network proxy tools like Charles or Fiddler over in-app inspectors
strengths: Provides a dedicated visual inspector UI with search and filtering capabilities
Supports optional password protection for the inspector
Allows copying requests directly to cURL format
weaknesses: Requires wrapping the app root with `DioRequestInspectorMain` and adding a navigator observer
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency, register the Dio interceptor, wrap your root app with DioRequestInspectorMain, and add DioRequestInspector.navigatorObserver to your MaterialApp.

alternatives.name: pretty_dio_logger
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer console-based pretty logging for Dio instead of an in-app visual inspector UI.

alternatives.name: talker
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a comprehensive, extensible logging and exception handling package with a visual payload viewer.
